product.title: Raw Hammer - Black / Grey
product.body_html:
Controlled Traction. Trusted Performance.

Hammer has never believed entry-level should mean ordinary. The Raw Hammer line was created to deliver true Hammer performance while giving bowlers meaningful options, whether it’s their first Hammer purchase or a strategic addition for an experienced player. The new Raw Hammer - Black/Grey Solid replaces the popular Black Solid and brings dependable traction at a strong value. Built to read the midlane with control and consistency, it delivers the kind of predictable motion bowlers can trust when lanes start to break down. It continues the Raw Hammer legacy of versatility and performance for bowlers of all skill levels.

BALL SPEC

  • PERFORMANCE Lower Mid
  • PART NUMBER 60-108607-93X
  • COLOR Black / Grey
  • CORE Raw Hammer
  • COVERSTOCK Juiced Solid
  • COVER TYPE Solid Reactive
  • FINISH 500, 1500, 3000 Siaair Micro Pad
  • WEIGHTS 16-10 Pounds
  • LANE CONDITION Medium oil
  • REACTION Strong arc
  • WARRANTY Two years from purchase date
  • RELEASE DATE May 14, 2026
